name: hacker-news-digest
objectives: Build a short Hacker News reading list from public story titles, links, scores and comment counts.
Assign choose-hn-topics using the mission input. Answer its topic question with all or comma-separated keywords; the controller runs the proposed fetch, filter, rank and write actions.
Keep up to five matching stories ordered by score, then comment count. Describe only the collected metadata; article contents have not been read.
Review digest.md and stories.json, then complete the operation with a short summary.
